transcript: Haan bol dijiye bol dijiye Haan ji haan very good morning sir Vikas dresses mein baat ho rahi hai Haan haan boliye na Harshita baat kar rahi thi main aapka sir jo product wagairah fabrics mein aap deal karte ho ya school bag wagairah bhi hai Aap Harjita bol rahe hain, kahan se bol rahe hain, kis kaaran se bolna hai zara batayenge. Haan ji sir main Ranchi branch se Harshita Business Growth Manager India Mart se baat kar rahi thi India Mart ch haanji Haan ji haan ji toh sir haan ji jo aapka product hai woh aap fabrics pe deal karte ho sir ya phir aapka school bag wagairah bhi hai aur ladies bag wagairah bhi hai sabse Ji ji sabhi tarah ka kapda aur usse related jitni bhi cheezein hoti hain na usmein deal karte hain Matlab uniforms hai aapka Ji ji Uniforms and school bags vagairah yeh saari cheez hai na Ji ji school shoes bhi ho School shoes vagairah bhi hai okay toh jaise India Mart pe aapka bhi is product ke regarding kuch requirement generate ho rahi thi basically customers ki toh aapka supply haan ji toh supply kahan tak hai sir abhi aapka Supply Hamara supply Ranchi Ranchi area mein Matlab local deal karte hain. Nahi, Rashi ke bahar bhi deal karte hain, lekin Rashi ke bahar direct party to party deal karte hain. Okay matlab like wholesaling mein Online mein agar bol rahe hain toh online mein Ranchi toh Ranchi hi karte hain Online mein Ranchi to Ranchi karte hain okay toh jaise India Mart ke baare mein knowledge toh hoga sir ki India Mart B to B market hai theek hai toh India Mart se jo bhi aapko aapke product ke regarding inquiry aati hai basically woh bulk ki inquiry hoti hai aur jaise location ho gaya toh aapka India Mart regional and national based kaam karta hai aur location ki ho gayi sir toh aap location apna jo map karvate ho onboarding ke time pe woh location hum aapko us location ke according hum aapko customer dete hain sir nahi Hum Haan ji aur poore month ka hamara jo customers ka vo hota hai ratio hota hai vo sir sixty to seventy hota hai per day ka do se teen ke ratio mein hum aapko provide karte hain Hoon Haan ji toh abhi jo requirements vagairah aayi hui hai woh aapke local aur near by kuch district se aayi hui hai toh aapka kitne kilometer matlab do sau kilometers hai ya all over Jharkhand supply hai kya hai aap bata sakte hain Theek hai Nahi nahi supply ke liye kahin bhi de sakte hain payment pehle chahiye hota uske baad supply jaati hai Haan ji bilkul India Mart ke side se jo customer hum aapko dete hain woh advance payment ke customer hote hain sir before delivery woh aapko full payment deliver karte hain then aap unko apna product deliver karte ho Hum Ji ji ji Ji toh iske regarding ek baar sir aapse meeting ho payegi kya jo aap apne shop pe available hain Toh iske regarding humko kya karna hoga Sir main ek baar aapse meeting chah rahi thi face to face jismein aapko India Mart ke regarding jo bhi benefits wagairah hain features wagairah hain jo customer hain unke saath aap kaise connect kar paoge aur aapke profile pe abhi kya requirement aayi hui hai customer ki wo saari cheezon ke regarding main aapse ek baar face to face meeting chah rahi thi jismein ek India Mart ka hamara demo bhi ho jata hai to uspe aapko saara cheez sir achhe se sir queries wagairah bhi aapki solve ho payegi Haan Haan Nahi toh queries ismein kya hai matlab aapka jaise requirement aaya ab aap mere ko transfer kar doge main party se baat kar loonga kya hai kya nahi mangane ka usse direct ho jayegi baat Hum hum Hum hum uske regarding hi main aapse ek baar meeting chah rahi hoon sir kyonki abhi jaise aapka free listed profile registered hai achha Ranchi pe aap nahi ho aapka ye free listed profile registered hai na India Mart pe abhi District profile registered hai Kaafi bol raha hai Haan haan Toh aap aapke free listed profile pe jo aapko inquiry wagairah aayi ho unke saath toh aap aise bhi abhi bhi apne profile pe yeh saara cheez check kar paoge sir Accha Haan ji aapka jaise main dekh rahi hoon app aapne abhi bhi install kar rakha hai toh aapke application pe aap ja kar ke by lead section se yeh check kar paoge ki kahan se kis cheez ke regarding kaise inquiry aayi hui hai. Toh IndiaMart ke aur benefits ko aap kaise receive kar sakte ho ya kaise aap benefit le sakte ho IndiaMart ka uske regarding main ek baar chah rahi thi ki ek baar aapke saath offline meeting ho. Offline meeting mein kya hota hai ki hum aapko jo das cheezein bata rahe hote hain usmein se aapki chaar toh always inquiry aati hi aati hai. aur Theek hai Toh vo aapko jo query aayegi uske regarding hi main chah rahi thi ki ek baar aapse offline discussion ho Theek hai na main aapko abhi Ranchi mein hoon nahi Ranchi aata hoon toh phir aapko phone kar loonga aapka number bata dijiye mere ko yahi number aap hi ka rahega yeh computerized call hai. Haan ji nahi nahi yeh same number hai aap is par connect kar sakte ho aur main aapse jaanna chahungi sir ki aap Ranchi return kab tak aa rahe hain main Main pachees tareekh ko aaunga Phir twenty fifth of Jan ko aap return aaoge. Ji Okay matlab twenty fifth ko aaoge ya twenty fourth ko aa jaoge to twenty fifth meeting ho payegi Nahi nahi twenty fifth ko hi aaunga. Toh phir aap chhabbis ya satais ko humko approach kar sakte hain uske liye. 25th Sir 26th toh actually Republic Day hai toh us din holiday hoga. Ya toh ya toh chhabbees ya sattais aap jis bhi din aap comfortable hon aap approach kar sakte hain. Hmm. Okay theek hai main pachas phir aapko ek baar connect kar loongi sir Okay Okay aap mera number save kar lo aap uske baad main aapko WhatsApp pe hi likh kar Harshata Kya naam bataya tha aapne Okay okay Harshada ji Okay sir main aapko ek baar phir
